result:
The 4-second lower third is built in `./s3/`, and `npx hyperframes check --json` reports no errors. It has one warning, `first_frame_empty`, which I left in. I haven't previewed or rendered it.

- **Animation:** "Mohammed" slides in from the left at 0.3 s and "Maintainer, Girth" at 0.45 s, with an accent bar growing alongside. All three finish by about 1.1 s and hold until 4 s.
- **Snapshots:** frames at 1 s, 3 s and 3.88 s show the card in the same position, bottom-left, so the hold works.
- **Warning:** frame 0 is empty because the card enters from off-screen. That matters only if you use frame 0 as a thumbnail; say if you want the card on screen at 0 s instead.
- **Files:** the scene is `compositions/lower-third.html` and `index.html` mounts it.
- **Editing:** name, title and accent colour are variables on `index.html`, so they can be changed without touching the animation.
- **Styling:** the font is Inter on a dark `#14161c` background with an orange accent.
